INTERFACE
Artist/album browsing: lk media artists or albums opens groups; Enter opens albums/tracks; Esc returns. lk media import opens the owner-local CD/DVD/Blu-ray workbench; --node selects a paired owner. Use lk media import --help for capture, title choice, metadata and job flags. lk media edit QUERY --artist NAME --all corrects shared metadata; --help lists the fields. Media Find: type or / filters; arrows move; Tab marks; A marks all shown; E edits metadata for selected tracks; R refreshes metadata; Enter plays; Q adds to queue; Esc ends search, clears filter, then exits.
